Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel insurance information
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Portable power bank

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes for beach activities
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for sun protection
- Rain jacket or poncho
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Lip balm with SPF

For Specific Activities:
- Waikiki Beach (June 11): Beach games, umbrella
- Hanauma Bay Snorkeling (June 12): Underwater camera
- Diamond Head Hiking (June 13): Extra water, trail snacks
- Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14): Respectful attire
- North Shore Road Trip (June 15): Car adapter for charging
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau (June 16): Hawaiian shirt or dress
- Hotel Spa Day (June 17): Spa sandals, robe (if not provided)
- Kailua Beach Kayaking (June 18): Quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- Ala Moana Shopping (June 19): Reusable shopping bags

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Earplugs and eye mask
- Small backpack for daily excursions
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
